license: Original project fiction; not adapted random tables

packs.appearance: Copper-stained gloves; a key tied to a reed whistle.
packs.voice: Counts costs on their fingers, then asks who will go thirsty.
packs.objective: Release the reserved water to the lower orchards before dawn.
packs.obstacle: The Orchard Commons holds an upstream charter forbidding release until its own cistern is full.
packs.offer: A guided dry-foot crossing and a share of fresh water for help checking the gate.
packs.boundary: Will not flood the occupied workers' cottages to save the fruit.
packs.relationship: {npc} maintains {location} for the Orchard Commons but owes the lower growers a promised release.
packs.secret: The charter's water gauge was reset by the Commons assessor; the upper cistern is already full.
channels: Compare the silt line with the freshly moved brass gauge.
Ask the night boat crew when the upper overflow began.
Inspect the duplicate gauge marks in the maintenance book.
packs.meaning: Proof can make a lawful release possible without taking the gate by force.
packs.purpose: An irrigation junction turned bargaining point between thirsty orchards.
sensory: A thin whistle rises from the strained gate chain.
Wet copper smells sharp beside sweet fallen fruit.

features.name: Counterweight cradle
features.interaction: Add ballast to hold the gate open without standing at the wheel.

features.name: Inspection channel
features.interaction: Drain its shallow water to read the older gauge marks or cross below the walkway.

packs.pressure: At dawn the Commons locks the gate for a week; the lower crop begins to fail.
packs.warning: The chain skips a tooth each time the wheel turns.
packs.trigger: Forcing the wheel without supporting its counterweight.
packs.danger: The gate slams and sweeps the walkway with a surge.
packs.counterplay: Brace the cradle, use the inspection channel, or leave the wheel alone.
packs.opportunity: A controlled release can supply both sides if the false reading is exposed.
choices: Bring the gauge evidence to the Commons.
Negotiate a shared release with the lower growers.
Use the dry channel to bypass the dispute or leave it unresolved.
edge_notes: A narrow stair beside the counterweight.
A low inspection arch; safe when drained.
packs.concept: Keeper of Water That Others Claim
packs.trouble: A Promise Downstream, a Charter Upstream
packs.bond: The Orchard Commons Still Has My Keys

packs.appearance: A leather apron patched with blue wool; a small tuning hammer.
packs.voice: Lets each answer ring in a deliberate pause.
packs.resource: a warning bell audible through the valley fog
packs.objective: Retune the warning bell before the night caravan enters the fog.
packs.obstacle: The Road Wardens have sealed the bell cradle as collateral for unpaid road repairs.
packs.offer: A safe caravan berth and a demonstration of the fog signals.
packs.boundary: Will not ring a false alarm to empty the wardens' post.
packs.relationship: {npc} forged the bell at {location}; the Road Wardens depend on its signals but control access to it.
packs.secret: The bell's crack came from an overloaded warden hoist, not a flaw in the casting.
channels: Match the hoist hook's brass scar to the cracked rim.
Ask the dawn watch why the hoist log is missing a page.
Compare the founder's test rubbings with the newer fracture.
packs.meaning: Evidence can shift liability and reopen the sealed cradle.
packs.purpose: A road-warning tower now held as disputed collateral.
sensory: A sour overtone hums when wind brushes the bell.
Cold fog beads on taut hemp hoist ropes.

features.name: Tuning bench
features.interaction: Test small chimes to reconstruct the warning code or identify the cracked note.

features.name: Service hoist
features.interaction: Raise tools through the hatch, or lower the bell's weight before inspecting its rim.

packs.pressure: The caravan reaches the blind ridge at moonrise without a reliable warning signal.
packs.warning: The hoist rope sheds pale fibers whenever the bell sways.
packs.trigger: Moving the bell without first lowering its weight onto the service blocks.
packs.danger: The hoist jerks loose and sends its load across the stair landing.
packs.counterplay: Block the bell, use the exterior ladder, or signal the caravan by lantern instead.
packs.opportunity: Repairing the code lets travelers organize safe passages without paying for escorts.
choices: Prove the source of the crack.
Negotiate temporary access against a repair guarantee.
Warn the caravan by another route and leave ownership unresolved.
edge_notes: A spiral stair with a waist-high rail.
A hatch crossed by the hoist rope.
packs.concept: Founder of the Valley's Warning Voice
packs.trouble: My Work Is Someone Else's Collateral
packs.bond: The Night Caravans Know My Signals
packs.hope: No Traveler Lost in the Fog

packs.appearance: A coat with labeled seed pockets and a clay moisture tile.
packs.voice: Names a plant for every possibility, then gets to the point.
packs.resource: the valley's surviving frost-resistant seed stock
packs.objective: Move the viable seed trays out of the damp vault before the next frost.
packs.obstacle: The Granary Council refuses to break the inventory seals during its ownership audit.
packs.offer: A packet of hardy seedlings and access to the planting records.
packs.boundary: Will not trade the final planting stock for personal passage out of the valley.
packs.relationship: {npc} curates {location} for the Granary Council, whose auditor suspects the seed count is inflated.
packs.secret: A blocked roof drain caused the damp; most missing seeds were moved to a dry loft, not stolen.
channels: Follow the water stains to the leaf-choked drain.
Inspect the loft's fresh tray tracks and matching inventory tags.
Ask the roof tender about the emergency drying work.
packs.meaning: The surviving stock can be counted honestly without accusing the night staff of theft.
packs.purpose: A communal planting archive caught between an audit and spreading damp.
sensory: Warm bean husks smell earthy near the drying rack.
Drops tick on the tin lids of sealed seed jars.

features.name: Drying rack
features.interaction: Redirect the warm flue beneath it to save wet trays or reveal damp labels.

features.name: Roof drain lever
features.interaction: Clear the leaf screen to stop incoming water; catch the runoff to inspect what washed down.

packs.pressure: The cold snap arrives tonight; damp stock left in the vault will split.
packs.warning: A wet ceiling beam bows over the sealed aisle.
packs.trigger: Stacking more trays under the sagging beam or climbing it unbraced.
packs.danger: The rack collapses, scattering fragile jars across the aisle.
packs.counterplay: Prop the beam, carry trays through the loft, or clear the drain first.
packs.opportunity: A shared drying effort can protect the next planting regardless of the audit's outcome.
choices: Document the loft stock for the auditor.
Organize growers to dry and reseal the trays.
Secure a small emergency allotment and let the council settle title.
edge_notes: A wide inventory door with breakable wax seals.
A service ladder beside the warm flue.
packs.trouble: Every Broken Seal Looks Like Theft

packs.appearance: Developer stains at the cuffs; a camera wrapped against the rain.
packs.voice: Frames each claim as something seen or something merely heard.
packs.objective: Make a second set of prints before the Transit Board's inspection closes the studio.
packs.obstacle: The building's electricity is cut and the only working drying cabinet is locked in the board's leased room.
packs.offer: A clear print of one requested street scene and access to the studio's back exit.
packs.boundary: Will not publish the faces of bystanders caught in the payoff photographs.
packs.relationship: {npc} rents {location} from the Transit Board; the landlord's inspection threatens the very evidence taken there.
packs.secret: A board courier visible in the photographs was returning the payoff, not delivering it.
channels: Read the reversed receipt in a higher-contrast print.
Ask the cab dispatcher which way the courier traveled afterward.
Compare the envelope's serial mark with the returned-payment ledger.
packs.meaning: The courier may become a witness rather than the obvious suspect.
packs.purpose: A portrait studio now used to duplicate politically dangerous photographs.
sensory: Acid fixer prickles the nose by the wash trays.
Rain drums on a skylight patched with red glass.

features.name: Battery enlarger
features.interaction: Focus a small print without mains power, choosing which detail to enlarge.

features.name: Shared drying cabinet
features.interaction: Open its service panel to circulate warm air or inspect the landlord's storage tags.

packs.pressure: The inspection team arrives at closing time and will seal all photographic materials.
packs.warning: Sparks snap under the wet cabinet cable.
packs.trigger: Powering the cabinet before isolating its damaged lead.
packs.danger: A short ignites the drying paper and blocks the leased-room door with smoke.
packs.counterplay: Disconnect the lead, dry prints on lines, or use the back exit before smoke builds.
packs.opportunity: Duplicate evidence lets several witnesses negotiate independently instead of trusting one custodian.
choices: Help make anonymized copies.
Trade proof for a public hearing or an inspection delay.
Follow the courier's route without taking the negatives.
edge_notes: A light-trap curtain preserves the darkroom.
A connecting door with a landlord's padlock.
packs.concept: Street Photographer with an Unwanted Scoop
packs.trouble: The Landlord Is in the Frame
packs.bond: The Night Dispatchers Know My Work

packs.appearance: A repaired headset and pencil notes folded into a sleeve.
packs.voice: Repeats the last few words of a request to verify its meaning.
packs.objective: Connect the isolated witnesses before the exchange is decommissioned tonight.
packs.obstacle: The Telephone Trust has ordered all outgoing trunks cut during the takeover.
packs.offer: One discreet call and a maintenance route through the exchange.
packs.boundary: Will not put an unwilling witness on an open party line.
packs.relationship: {npc} runs the night shift at {location}; the Telephone Trust wants its staff gone before the records change hands.
packs.secret: The threatened calls passed through a still-live test trunk omitted from the shutdown list.
channels: Trace the test lamp that flashes after the main trunks are cut.
Ask the retiring line tester which trunk was never billed.
Compare patch-card holes with the official circuit diagram.
packs.meaning: The test trunk offers a route to warn witnesses and identify whoever still uses it.
packs.purpose: A telephone exchange awaiting takeover with one unlisted line still active.
sensory: Relay clicks travel along the supposedly dead rack.
Hot dust hangs in the air behind the switchboard.

features.name: Patch board
features.interaction: Bridge a verified circuit to connect callers or listen for its routing tone.

features.name: Test cabinet
features.interaction: Isolate a trunk and light its destination indicator without sending a call.

packs.pressure: At midnight the Trust removes the routing cards and scatters the night staff.
packs.warning: A cracked battery cell hisses beneath the rack.
packs.trigger: Throwing the main disconnect while the cracked cell remains linked.
packs.danger: A hot arc severs the trunk and throws burning insulation into the service aisle.
packs.counterplay: Isolate the cell first, use the manual patch circuit, or warn people in person.
packs.opportunity: A temporary caller network can keep witnesses in touch without revealing a single meeting place.
choices: Restore a private link with consent.
Preserve the routing cards for an independent inquiry.
Trace the test trunk or arrange an entirely different warning route.
edge_notes: A narrow insulated walkway beside the trunk cable.
packs.concept: Last Operator on a Dying Network
packs.trouble: The Trust Owns the Wires, Not My Silence
packs.bond: The Night Staff Still Answer Me

packs.appearance: A rain-dark timetable coat and a brass ticket punch.
packs.voice: Uses departure times instead of vague promises.
packs.resource: the last legal ferry crossing before a harbor closure
packs.objective: Get the stranded shift workers across before the closure takes effect.
packs.obstacle: The Harbor Commission has impounded the passenger manifest over a disputed charter fee.
packs.offer: Reserved deck passage and a berth under the pier office.
packs.boundary: Will not overload the ferry or sail with an uncounted passenger.
packs.relationship: {npc} dispatches from {location}; the Harbor Commission controls the paperwork but depends on the same ferry crews.
packs.secret: The closure order allows one documented emergency crossing, but its exception page was filed separately.
channels: Compare the order's page count with the pier copy.
Ask the commission typist about the carbon copy sent to the tug office.
Read the exception reference on the impound receipt.
packs.meaning: A counted crossing is legally possible without bribing the pier inspector.
packs.purpose: A ferry ticket office turned holding pen for a stranded night shift.
sensory: Diesel coughs under the waiting gangway.
A loose mooring ring knocks in time with the swell.

features.name: Ticket punch ledger
features.interaction: Count passengers and document an exception crossing without surrendering their home addresses.

features.name: Tide winch
features.interaction: Adjust the gangway to board safely or lower it onto a service float.

packs.pressure: The barrier tender closes the harbor at the next tide signal.
packs.warning: The gangway pin creeps outward each time the swell lifts it.
packs.trigger: Driving a loaded cart onto the unpinned gangway.
packs.danger: The gangway drops a corner and spills cargo into the water.
packs.counterplay: Secure the pin, board in small groups, or use the sheltered service float.
packs.opportunity: A properly witnessed manifest can establish the workers' right to an emergency crossing.
choices: Find and invoke the exception page.
Negotiate a counted crossing with the barrier tender.
Arrange shore shelter or take the long land route instead.
edge_notes: A low ladder usable near slack water.
packs.concept: Dispatcher Who Knows Every Last Boat
packs.trouble: A Good Crossing Needs Bad Paperwork
packs.bond: The Night Shift Counts on Me

packs.appearance: A pressure patch on one sleeve; a clipped portable gas sampler.
packs.voice: States a measurement, then asks what risk everyone accepts.
packs.resource: a reserve of clean breathing mix
packs.objective: Route reserve air to the crowded shelter ring before its scrubbers saturate.
packs.obstacle: Orbital Utilities has frozen the valve authorization during a billing dispute.
packs.offer: A sealed service route and a portable air cartridge.
packs.boundary: Will not vent an inhabited compartment to save the billing hub.
packs.relationship: {npc} services {location} for Orbital Utilities but has family sheltering in the ring that needs its reserve.
packs.secret: The reserve can feed both rings if a faulty return sensor is bypassed; the shortage is mostly a control error.
channels: Compare the portable sampler with the return sensor's flat reading.
Ask the maintenance drone operator about rejected calibration tickets.
Inspect the test loop's normal pressure while the main panel reports empty.
packs.meaning: A verified repair can avoid choosing which inhabited ring loses air.
packs.purpose: An atmosphere recycling hub caught between a false shortage and a frozen authorization.
sensory: Fan blades beat a slow pulse through the deck.
Condensation tastes faintly metallic at the leaking return flange.

features.name: Calibration loop
features.interaction: Run a sealed test sample to distinguish an empty reserve from a bad sensor.

features.name: Manual manifold
features.interaction: Rebalance clean mix between rings after checking the pressure differential.

packs.pressure: The shelter scrubbers saturate at the next watch change.
packs.warning: A red differential strip trembles across the manifold seal.
packs.trigger: Opening the manifold fully before equalizing the test loop.
packs.danger: A pressure surge slams a service hatch and isolates the valve aisle.
packs.counterplay: Equalize in stages, use the maintenance crawlway, or supply cartridges while testing.
packs.opportunity: Repairing the return sensor restores a common reserve without sacrificing a habitat ring.
choices: Document and repair the sensor fault.
Bargain for a supervised manual release.
Distribute cartridges or evacuate the shelter by another route.
edge_notes: A service crawlway with hand valves.
packs.bond: My Family Waits in the Shelter Ring

packs.appearance: A thermal wrap and a wrist display full of checksum notes.
packs.voice: Separates what is verified from what is only inferred.
packs.resource: the only intact route archive for a displaced colony
packs.objective: Copy the route archive before the vault's coolant allocation expires.
packs.obstacle: The Migration Office has revoked export access while it disputes the colonists' claim to the data.
packs.offer: A verified star-route fragment and a secure offline storage wafer.
packs.boundary: Will not erase the colonists' identity records to make the route file fit.
packs.relationship: {npc} preserves {location} for the Migration Office but promised displaced navigators access to their own routes.
packs.secret: The route file is public survey data; only the attached identity index is under legal restriction.
channels: Read the original survey license in the offline catalog.
Ask the retired survey pilot about the public deposit receipt.
Compare the route file's signature with the office's restricted-file index.
packs.meaning: Separating the index from the route data may permit lawful copying without exposing identities.
packs.purpose: A cryogenic data archive awaiting an allocation shutdown.
sensory: Ice crystals chime against the return duct grille.
Amber status lights crawl across frost-clouded cabinet glass.

features.name: Offline catalog
features.interaction: Trace file provenance without sending a query to the office network.

features.name: Cold transfer dock
features.interaction: Copy a verified subset onto a wafer or isolate a failing cabinet.

packs.pressure: Coolant stops at the next allocation cycle; warmer cabinets begin corrupting first.
packs.warning: A coolant return pipe ticks sharply and grows a white frost collar.
packs.trigger: Opening a hot cabinet while its cold transfer line remains pressurized.
packs.danger: A brittle seal parts and sprays freezing coolant across the transfer bridge.
packs.counterplay: Depressurize the line, use a remote transfer, or route around the bridge.
packs.opportunity: An anonymized public copy can let the colonists navigate without surrendering private records.
choices: Verify the survey license and separate the files.
Negotiate emergency cooling while claims are heard.
Copy a smaller route subset or evacuate fragile wafers instead.
edge_notes: A clear partition with an offline cable pass-through.
A grated bridge over the coolant return.
packs.concept: Archivist of a Colony's Way Home
packs.hope: A Route Home Without a Surveillance Trail

packs.appearance: Magnetic boots scuffed silver; antenna tags braided onto a tether.
packs.voice: Checks the listener's understanding with a short signal-code phrase.
packs.resource: a navigation beacon through the debris lane
packs.objective: Restore the beacon before the cooperative's convoy enters the debris lane.
packs.obstacle: The Freight Cooperative has locked the replacement power cell behind a salvage-title dispute.
packs.offer: A plotted safe approach and use of a spare tether rig.
packs.boundary: Will not spoof a clean lane when the debris has not been scanned.
packs.relationship: {npc} rigs antennas at {location}; the Freight Cooperative owns the cell but needs the beacon to guide its convoy.
packs.secret: The cell was recovered under a rescue clause that permits emergency use before salvage title is settled.
channels: Inspect the rescue seal under the newer salvage tag.
Ask the retrieval tug pilot for the recovery beacon log.
Read the emergency-use clause cached in the cell controller.
packs.meaning: Emergency activation need not settle who eventually owns the recovered cell.
packs.purpose: A field of tethered relay antennas darkened by a disputed salvage claim.
sensory: Loose tether clips tap a repeating rhythm against the access rail.
A pale power corona flickers at the broken feed coupling.

features.name: Scan mast
features.interaction: Sweep a narrow lane for debris before publishing a route.

features.name: Cell coupling
features.interaction: Isolate the feed, fit the spare cell, or divert its charge to a rescue lamp.

packs.pressure: The convoy commits to the debris approach at the next burn window.
packs.warning: The access rail twists whenever a loose antenna swings into its tether.
packs.trigger: Releasing the antenna's last clamp without attaching a second tether.
packs.danger: The free mast sweeps across the rail and strands anyone beyond the junction.
packs.counterplay: Rig a second tether, use boot anchors, or work from the service pod.
packs.opportunity: A verified rescue activation can guide the convoy while leaving ownership open to arbitration.
choices: Invoke the rescue clause and log every unit of power.
Negotiate a temporary cell loan.
Guide the convoy by a slower route or send a service pod ahead.
edge_notes: A clipped handline across open vacuum.
A flexing access rail with two anchor points.
packs.concept: Rigger of the Only Honest Beacon
packs.trouble: A Salvage Claim Between Us and the Convoy
packs.bond: The Tug Crews Trust My Signals
packs.hope: A Safe Lane That Belongs to Everyone
